svg.title: Pulsus Dash — 3D flame: checkout CPU profile during INC-2041
svg.desc: 3D flame graph of the checkout CPU profile for 12:10–12:40 against the previous 30 minutes. Frames are true 3D boxes: X = share of total, depth = stack depth, height = self time; the top orthographic view is the icicle. Suspects rail with the hottest frame json::encode first (HOTTEST, HOT, REGRESSED; glow 0.91), then psp_client::retry_wait (HOT, NEW, REGRESSED; glow 1.0), regex::compile, http2::frame and gc::mark. json::encode and psp_client::retry_wait glow in proportion to growth. Billboard labels with leader lines and rank badges, a merged slab of 214 frames, the hot path outlined, crumbs, view, mode, projection and Axes controls, orbit gizmo, axis cube, coverage, a minimap icicle with the camera frustum and Dock 2D, the Inspector frame card and the top table.
